moon_base/all.explanation: The top-ranked investigation [PSI-99] SAFFIRE-II (84.8/100) and second-ranked [PSI-98] SAFFIRE-I (84.3/100) lead because both match the ventilated airflow scenario, earn top scores for testing solid habitat materials and data richness, and receive high oxygen scores. Third-ranked [PSI-68] FLEX-2 (77.0/100) achieves a maximum score for oxygen by testing within the scenario's 30% O₂ range and matches the ventilated airflow, but receives a lower overall score because it evaluated liquid droplet fuels rather than habitat materials.

iss_cabin/all.explanation: SAFFIRE-I [PSI-98] and SAFFIRE-II [PSI-99] rank highest with matching scores of 93.4/100 because both perfectly match the ventilated airflow scenario, test solid habitat materials, score 10/10 for richness, and test oxygen levels just 0.5 points away from the 21% scenario. BASS-II [PSI-25] ranks third with a score of 82.0/100 because its tested oxygen range fully includes the 21% target and it covers two pillars (prevention and suppression), though it received 0/15 points for airflow because the data was not reported.

spacesuit/all.explanation: The highest-ranking investigation, [PSI-98] SAFFIRE-I (total score 49.0/100), earned maximum points for material (20/20) and richness (10/10), alongside 14/20 for covering the prevention pillar and 5/15 for flow, despite scoring 0/35 on oxygen. Ranked second, [PSI-99] SAFFIRE-II also achieved a 49.0/100 total score with identical category point breakdowns, testing solid fuels including cotton, Nomex, PMMA, silicone, and SIBAL across 15 test rows. Ranking third, [PSI-100] SAFFIRE-III also scored 49/100 with the same point allocations for material, pillars, richness, and flow, though its oxygen level was not reported.

moon_base/detection.explanation: [PSI-102] ranks highest with a total score of 64/100 because it covers the detection focus, matches the ventilated scenario's airflow, tests solid habitat materials like silicone and Kapton, and includes an experimental table with four measurement types. [PSI-101] ranks second with 50/100 by also covering the detection focus and testing solid habitat materials like foam and Kapton with high data richness, though its airflow is not reported in the tables. [PSI-60] ranks third with 28/100 because while it covers the detection focus, it tests gaseous fuels without named habitat materials, has no reported airflow, and offers lower richness with only two measurement types and no experimental table.
